reviews.text: Knowledgeable and great staff - our favorites when it comes to the vet. Both cat and dog are followed up by Bjerke smådyr - and we think they handle our animals so well. Our dog is now almost excited to go to the vet - and is always very happy afterwards ☺️ (like us two-legged friends). Recommended ☺️
Super service! Skilled veterinarians and animal caretakers 😊 …

Good veterinarians, but some of the staff have a lot to do with humanity when delivering and leaving your animal behind. Was between 2 or 3 stars. Expectations were high based on previous reviews, but it did not live up to them.

We have used Karin U. Stormoen as a veterinarian for our dogs before Bjerke Smådyr existed.
The reason is: Karin is a very skilled diagnostician, an eminent surgeon and a nice person.
Veterinarian Karin is an incredibly skilled, experienced and reliable veterinarian.
